On Tue, Jun 22, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sam Holden <sam@optiretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the run-through today...

Sam — thanks, that’s helpful. Attached is a working MAP (OptiRetail_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short README for the prompt pack. High level commitments: deliver prompt pack + 1k testcases into an ephemeral sandbox, 30-day TTL (opt-in), manifest export (read-only CSV), and an acceptance window (two-week QA after delivery).

Draft entitlements matrix (summary):
- Access scope: up to 6 named OptiRetail engineers (POC-managed) + 2 reviewer seats for human QA.
- Token TTL: sandbox access tokens expire after 30 days; we issue a single renewal request if needed (subject to MAP milestones).
- Exports: read-only manifest CSV + fingerprinted snippets (we apply our artifact fingerprinter to each file to trace usage).
- Usage: evaluation-only; no production inference, no redistribution.

Open items for your procurement/legal: watermarking/fingerprint language, liability cap for ephemeral copies, and an optional audit window (48h notice for on-demand logs).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm named seats and procurement timeline.
2) Redwood sends a short MPA addendum with entitlements and expiry language (I'll include marissa & ben).
3) We schedule delivery for July 6 (sandbox creds live) and QA window July 6–20.

Attached: OptiRetail_MAP_v3.xlsx, promptpack-sample-README.md

—Grace

Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-06-23T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and dataset exchange - OptiRetail pilot (licensing + ops clarifications)

Folks — quick clarifications from ops and pricing so procurement has what it needs: 

1) Licensing/usage: The entitlements Grace listed are standard for evaluation: explicit "evaluation-only" clause, prohibition on model training/derivative datasets, and a 30-day retention TTL. If OptiRetail needs longer retention for human QA samples, we can support a single 30-day extension request (manual approval) tied to a milestone.

2) Sandbox access: We'll provision an ephemeral VPC sandbox with read-only manifests and bucket-level access for the named seats. Credentials are short-lived (30 days). Data egress for debug exports can be enabled but will require a signed export request traceable in the audit log (we'll include the export ID).

3) Fingerprinting / provenance: As Grace noted, we apply a lightweight fingerprint to each file so any exported sample carries an opaque ID. This helps both sides for compliance during acceptance. It's not a visible watermark — it's an artifact tag in the manifest.

4) SLOs and delivery cadence: We can commit to delivery of the prompt pack + testcases on 2026-07-06 if we get MAP sign-off by 2026-06-30 (EOD PT). Otherwise the earliest delivery slips by one sprint (2 weeks).

Attachments: a short ops checklist and an example export workflow will be shared after we get the PO/MPA sign-off.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: ops-checklist.pdf]
From: Lara Nguyen <legal@optiretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sam Holden <sam@optiretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and dataset exchange - OptiRetail pilot (legal note)

Grace / Ben — thank you for the clear breakdown. A couple of legal requests from OptiLegal before procurement greenlights the MPA: 

- Please add a short clause that evaluation artifacts are restricted to "evaluation-only" and must not be used to train models or for benchmarking against production systems outside the sandbox.
- We need the TTL and the extension mechanism documented in the addendum (how to request, approval SLA, and a limit of one extension).
- Clarify the audit access: OptiRetail requests read access to export logs for the 30-day window (redacted PII). If Redwood only permits 48h notice, we can accept that, but need it explicitly documented.
- Liability: standard mutual indemnity; for evaluation artifacts we ask a carve-out clarifying no third-party redistributions without express consent.

If you can update the MAP addendum and send a one-page exhibit with entitlements + example export flow (bullet list) by EOD Thursday (2026-06-26), we will route to procurement and aim to sign the addendum by 2026-06-30.

Regards,
Lara Nguyen
Counsel | OptiRetail
